value.name: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy)
value.notes: WestLight Energy's own site confirms it is San Mateo County's CCA, formed in 2015 after every city council in the county voted to establish it, serving the entire county (all cities/towns, including Foster City) since 2017. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service. Note: this organization rebranded from 'Peninsula Clean Energy' to 'WestLight Energy' — confirmed via a live 301 redirect from peninsulacleanenergy.com to westlightenergy.org this session; earlier records in this dataset citing 'Peninsula Clean Energy' by that name were not retroactively renamed this session and are flagged as a candidate for a future correction pass.
